id: title:jonmcwest:stop masking version strings as ip addresses

review.posthog_relevance: Changes the IP-address masking behavior in log redaction, potentially reducing false positives where an IP is misclassified as a version or sentence-ending token while preserving true IPs after delimiters and in URLs.
review.reason: Adds a negative lookbehind and lookahead to the IP regex and retains the original dotted-quad pattern, while adding a test case for an IP address embedded in a URL. This could prevent false positives where an IP is misclassified as a version or sentence-ending token, while preserving true IPs after delimiters and in URLs.
review.uncertainty: The benefit relies on the assumption that the updated regex will not mistakenly mask version strings as IPs, though the provided test case uses a version-like string rather than an actual IP, so the relevance is indirect.
